text:
Sam: Quick thread 1: we need a micro-drip plan for beta users that ties the newsletter -> webinar -> demo funnel. Goal: push high-intent beta users to book a 1:1 without spamming the broader list.
Rina: Proposal: 3-email micro-drip over 8 days to beta_eligible cohort only. Email1 = teaser + blog link, Email2 = webinar invite (soft-gate), Email3 = demo CTA + limited-offer (trial boost). Keep frequency low for the rest of list.
Marco: Agree. Segmentation rules: beta_eligible = signed-up >=30d AND usage >2 sessions last 14d AND not converted. Size estimate ~1.1k. Exclude users with unsub_flag or high_bounce.
Jules: Creative notes: keep subject lines short for mobile; use first name token for beta group. For Email2 (webinar) include an early-access CTA: "Book a 1:1 before the webinar" so sales can pre-qualify.
Sam: Good. What about A/B subject lines and measurement?
Rina: A/B plan: Email1 50/50 curiosity vs benefit. Email2 run 40/40/20 (technical hook / outcome hook / short invite). Track: open, register, itc (invite-to-conversion), and downstream demo requests.
Marco: Routing: registrants with company size >200 -> tag "sdr-qual" and route to SDR queue. Small companies -> nurture flow. sdr-bot: implemented rule mapping based on company_size field.
Jules: Deliverability: run seed test and spam-check. Also throttle sends to beta_eligible to 1k/min to avoid provider limits. deliveries-bot: throttle set to 800/min for this campaign.
Sam: Timing: send Email1 Day0 10am PST, Email2 Day3 10am local for region-stagger, Email3 Day8 11am local. APAC gets Email2 on Day4 local morning to avoid late-night.
Rina: UTM scheme: utm_source=newsletter, utm_medium=email, utm_campaign=beta-microdrip-2026. Add param utm_variant=subjectA/B. Also add header for tracking: X-Campaign-ID: beta-microdrip-1788888001.
Marco: Registration landing has calendar .ics and auto-attach option. Sales webhook will include registrant metadata. sdr-bot: webhook routing tested, mapping fields: email, company, company_size, role.
Jules: Copy owners: Rina for Email1, Marco for Email2, Sam for Email3. Deliverables: final subject lines, preheader, CTA URLs, and one-sentence beta incentive.
Sam: Can analytics provide forecast for demo conversions? want expected demo_count so SDRs can staff.
Marco: rough: reg rate 12%, demo conversion from reg 18% -> with 1.1k cohort = ~145 regs, ~26 demos. Include 95% CI +/- 30%.
Rina: Suppression: exclude anyone who got a paid-pricing outreach in last 14 days and anyone with "no-marketing" tag. Also exclude any who clicked "not interested" in previous beta nudges.
Jules: Legal: make sure we don't promise SLA or pricing discounts in mass email. Sam will send copy for review by EOD tomorrow.
deliveries-bot: Campaign "Beta Micro-Drip: Newsletter -> Webinar -> Demo" scheduled: 2026-04-12T16:00:00Z (staggering enabled).
sdr-bot: SDR queue rule updated: add tag "beta-webinar-reg" to incoming leads and assign to queue: beta-sdr-west.
Sam: Thanks all. I'll upload final audience CSV and confirm send windows. Please add any copy edits to the doc: https://docs.google.com/document/d/beta-microdrip-draft.
